## Football Concussion Brain Data {.unnumbered}


### Description

Brain measurements comparing football players (with and without
concussion history) to non-football-playing controls.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>football
</code></pre>


### Format

A data frame with 3 variables:


<dl>
<dt>group</dt><dd>Control (1), Football no concussion (2), Football with concussion (3)
</dd>
<dt>years</dt><dd>Years of football played
</dd>
<dt>volume</dt><dd>Total hippocampus volume in cubic centimeters
</dd>
</dl>



### Source

Singh R, Meier T, et al., JAMA, 311(18), 2014.
